name: Kanly
description: Adds a Kanly game style (five-minute rounds, then fast-rising water, with a generous loadout) and four Kanly Weapon Factory presets to the vanilla menus, and replaces the sudden-death music with four Kanly tracks. Client-side: a host's style reaches the other players by the normal game protocol.
